questions.q: When all the distinct parts and elements of an artwork work together to create a feeling of completeness, oneness, and pleasing arrangement, which principle is achieved?
questions.explain: Harmony, often called Unity, is achieved when all elements of a composition relate well to one another, creating a visually pleasing, cohesive whole rather than a disjointed collection of parts.
